name: aiha-exposure-assessment-strategy
title: 暴露评估策略起草者
description: Use this skill when a CIH, ROH, CSP, or EHS manager needs to draft an AIHA-aligned occupational exposure assessment strategy for a workplace, process, or Similar Exposure Group (SEG). Covers basic characterization, SEG construction, qualitative AIHA exposure rating, quantitative sampling plan, and statistical analysis. Produces a DRAFT strategy with an unsigned CIH/ROH/CSP review block for licensed industrial-hygiene review before any respiratory-protection or control-banding decisions.
